pain.title: The costliest mistakes when buying at auction cost more than the training
pain.subtitle: This isn't theory. These are real losses we see in beginners every week.
items: Bought a car cheaper but ignored shipping, fees, port, repair and paperwork
Trusted the photos but didn't check VIN, history, seller and prior bids
Didn't understand the title and bought a car that's hard or impossible to register cleanly
Set the wrong max bid and burned the margin
Didn't grasp which states and auctions are friendlier for logistics
Bought a car with damage that looks light but is expensive to repair
Had no checklist and decided emotionally
Paid a broker without understanding exactly what they're paying for

faq.q: Can I submit a request without taking the course?
faq.a: Base lessons are mandatory — they cover the main risks. The rest can be taken in parallel.

faq.q: Why are some lessons mandatory?
faq.a: It protects both sides: you don't submit a request without understanding, and we don't execute bids that hurt the client.

faq.q: Can I buy a car entirely on my own?
faq.a: In Basic — yes, you prepare the lot and the request yourself. The manager just executes the bid within your limit.

faq.q: What does the manager do?
faq.a: Reviews the request, executes the bid in your limit via Car Auctions, oversees payment and logistics after winning.

faq.q: Can the manager block a bid?
faq.a: Yes — if the lot has obvious risks that make the purchase unviable or unsafe.

faq.q: What if I change my mind after picking a car?
faq.a: Up to bid confirmation, you can drop the lot and pick another.

faq.q: Can I switch packages?
faq.a: Yes. We credit the price difference on upgrade within the active package term.

faq.q: Is there support after winning?
faq.a: Yes. All delivery statuses are visible in the dashboard, and the manager answers questions.

directAccess.title: Direct Car Auctions access
directAccess.body: Basic, Pro and Partner don't get direct dealer access to the internal Car Auctions. This is for process safety: the bid is executed by a manager in the agreed limit.

faq.q: Will I get a Copart login?
faq.a: Direct client access — no. The manager executes bids in your limit. Partner can get their own dealer account after a contract.

faq.q: Can I bid myself?
faq.a: On Basic, Pro and Partner — no. On Partner — yes, after contract, deposit and vetting.

faq.q: Why doesn't BidBIDDERS open Car Auctions to everyone?
faq.a: It's a professional tool. Without vetting and process understanding it creates major risk for the client and reputational risk for our dealer account.

faq.q: Is there Manheim access?
faq.a: Yes, via the manager. Manheim is a dealer auction — direct client access is closed.

faq.q: Can I buy from Europe?
faq.a: Yes. The base includes BCA and Copart Germany plus other local European platforms.

faq.q: Copart or IAAI — which is better?
faq.a: Depends on the lot. Both are large. The course has a module with examples when one is better than the other.

faq.q: Which auction fits a beginner?
faq.a: Usually Copart or IAAI in the US — they have the most explanation, photos and examples. European platforms come next.

faq.q: Why can a cheap lot be unprofitable?
faq.a: Because the full price includes dozens of additional costs. Module 5 of the course covers this.

risk.title: Safety and risk in buying cars at auction
risk.subtitle: We don't hide risk — it's part of an honest product. This page shows what depends on us, what depends on you, and what we cannot guarantee.

existing.title: What risks exist
items: A car may have hidden damage not visible in photos
Title may cause registration issues in the client's country
Delivery from a specific location may be more expensive than expected
Repair may cost more than the reserve
Customs rules may change between bid and delivery

ourSide.title: How we reduce risk
items: Mandatory lessons before the first bid
Manager review before executing a bid
Right to refuse a request with obvious risk

clientSide.title: What depends on the client
items: Stating the budget and goal honestly
Accepting that some lots are better skipped

noGuarantee.title: What we can't guarantee
items: The exact winning price — the auction decides
Absence of hidden defects not visible in documents or photos
Exact delivery dates to 100% — depends on ports and customs

emotions.title: Why max bid matters more than emotions
emotions.body: The most common beginner mistake — raising max bid 'just one more' under bidding pressure. This usually destroys the margin or pushes the deal into a loss. The course teaches how to compute max bid and stick to it.

legalDisclaimer.title: What the course does not replace
legalDisclaimer.body: BidBIDDERS Academy lessons do not replace individual legal, tax or technical advice for a specific vehicle. Before deciding to buy or sell, consult qualified specialists in your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 1. General
paragraphs: These Terms govern the use of the BidBIDDERS Academy service and the purchase of access to the paid online course.
The seller and operator is the entity listed in the “Seller details” section above. Contact — the email and phone in the seller details and on the Contact page.

sections.heading: 2. Subject of the service
paragraphs: The service provides access to digital content — the BidBIDDERS Academy online course (15 lessons plus materials: checklists, templates, calculator) in the chosen package: Basic, Pro or Partner.
The course is educational and does not replace individual legal, tax or technical advice. Buying a car at auction always carries risk.

sections.heading: 3. Placing an order
paragraphs: An order is placed by selecting a package and completing the purchase form. Placing an order requires acceptance of these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
The contract is concluded upon payment confirmation.

sections.heading: 4. Prices and payment
paragraphs: Package prices are in Polish złoty (PLN), gross. Current prices: Basic 800 zł, Pro 1700 zł, Partner 2700 zł (unless stated otherwise on the site).
Online payments are handled by Przelewy24 — operator PayPro S.A. (ul. Pastelowa 8, 60-198 Poznań). The seller does not store payment card data.

sections.heading: 5. Service delivery
paragraphs: Access to the course is granted electronically, immediately after the payment is booked, to the email provided in the order.
A device with internet access and a modern browser is sufficient.

sections.heading: 6. Right of withdrawal
paragraphs: A consumer may withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving a reason.

For digital content supplied before that period ends, starting performance with the consumer's express consent and after informing them of the loss of the right results in the loss of the right of withdrawal (Art. 38 of the Consumer Rights Act).

sections.heading: 7. Complaints
paragraphs: Complaints can be sent to the seller's email and should include the buyer's details and a description of the issue.
Complaints are handled within 14 days.

sections.heading: 8. Personal data
paragraphs: Personal data processing is described in the Privacy Policy available on the site.

sections.heading: 9. Final provisions
paragraphs: Matters not covered by these Terms are governed by Polish law. The seller may amend the Terms for valid reasons; orders placed before a change are governed by the version in force at the time of purchase.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is the entity listed in the “Seller details” section above. Data contact — the email in the seller details.

sections.heading: 2. Scope of data
paragraphs: We process data provided at registration and purchase: name, email, phone, country, and data needed for payment (processed by the payment operator).

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Data is processed to conclude and perform the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), to meet legal obligations including tax (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR), and in the controller's legitimate interest — handling enquiries and security (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.heading: 4. Payments
paragraphs: Payments are handled by Przelewy24 — PayPro S.A., which is a separate data controller for transaction processing. Payment data is passed directly to the operator.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
paragraphs: Data is kept for the term of the contract and the period required by law (including tax law), then deleted or anonymised.

sections.heading: 6. Recipients
paragraphs: Data may be shared with providers supporting the service (hosting, payments, email) only to the extent necessary and under processing agreements.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability and to object, and the right to lodge a complaint with the data protection authority (PUODO).

sections.heading: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses cookies. Details are in the Cookies Policy available on the site.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
paragraphs: For personal data matters, contact the email listed in the seller details.
